summary: End-to-end testing of new admin auth + admin CRUD + EN/RU/UA i18n features. Backend: 23/23 pytest passing (auth login/me, token validation, admin inquiries/contacts/products CRUD, JNOD slug+Lieferzeit specs, public endpoints, graceful empty RESEND_API_KEY). Frontend: admin login redirects to /admin, dashboard renders with all 3 tabs (Anfragen/Kontakte/Produkte), full product CRUD via UI works (create + edit + delete confirm dialog), logout clears token and protected route redirects unauthenticated visits back to /admin/login. i18n: EN ('Home/Shop' + 'Discover products' CTA), RU ('Главная' + 'Смотреть продукты'), UA ('Головна' + 'Дивитися продукти') all working AND persist via localStorage after reload.

minor.issue: Returns plain list (not Pydantic model). Acceptable but inconsistent with other endpoints — consider InquiryOut response_model for OpenAPI schema completeness.
After update returns merged dict directly converted back to Product model; created_at re-parsed from isoformat string — works but a bit fragile. No bug observed.

issues: Editor opens inline pushing list down (no modal/scroll-to-view). On long lists user has to scroll up to find the form after clicking 'Neues Produkt'.

When token is present from prior session but expired, page silently shows a transient 403 console error before redirecting — harmless but noisy. Consider clearing localStorage token on 401/403 in api.js interceptor.

action_items: (Optional) Add api.js global 401 interceptor that clears 'ecobt_admin_token' and redirects to /admin/login to silence the 403 console error on stale tokens.
(Optional) Wrap ProductEditor in a sticky panel or scroll into view on open so the form is visible immediately on click.
Carry over from iteration 1: several product images still 404 (Squirrel M30 25/30/35kW, Smart LED-Streifen 5m, Smart LED-Deckenleuchte 36W, Smart LED-Lampe E27/GU10). Replace seed image URLs.
Carry over from iteration 1: add data-testid='cart-button' to header cart icon and data-testids to /shop category filter chips.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~1250 lines and contains models, seed data, public + admin routes, and auth wiring all in one file — should be split into routers/ (admin.py, products.py, auth.py), models.py, seed/.

JWT secret is hardcoded into backend/.env at 96 hex chars — good entropy. Bcrypt is used correctly via passlib alternative (bcrypt lib). seed_admin is idempotent and updates password hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes. ✓

make_require_admin verifies role=='admin' on every protected request via DB lookup — adds latency. Acceptable for current scale; consider caching role into JWT payload to avoid the per-request db.users.find_one.
send_inquiry_email correctly logs 'RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email notification' and never raises; inquiry POST stays 200. ✓
ProductUpdate model omits 'slug' which is correct (slug is the route param and treated as immutable on PUT).

seed_data_creation: Test products are created with slug 'test-admin-product' and deleted by tests. Pytest creates TEST_-prefixed inquiries and contacts via existing /api/inquiries and /api/contact endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_auth.py (admin/auth) and /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (public). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Admin token is stored in localStorage key 'ecobt_admin_token'. Language preference is persisted in localStorage (key likely 'ecobt_lang') and survives reload. Only Header/Home hero are translated — other pages remain in German (acceptable for P2 scope). Resend API key intentionally empty in .env — inquiry creation logs 'RESEND_API_KEY not set' and still returns 200. JNOD heat pump slugs (5 new ones) all resolve and contain specs.Lieferzeit.
rca of the issue: No critical issues to RCA. The only observable noise was a transient 403 from /api/auth/me when an expired token sits in localStorage — root cause: api.js does not clear stale tokens on 401/403. Mitigation: add a response interceptor that clears localStorage['ecobt_admin_token'] when /api/auth/me returns 401/403.
